what: pixel size of the b2 and b3 SEM frames, recovered from the instrument databar that survives in the uncropped originals
why: scale.from_tiff() finds no FEI block in any of these files and the project's extracted metadata table covers only the MAR_* frames, so without this the specimen series the paper reports on has no pixel size and no figure drawn from it can carry a scale bar

method.reported: the annotated length of the drawn scale bar divided by the measured span between its two end ticks
method.control: the printed horizontal field width divided by the frame width in pixels, an independent number from the same strip
method.hand_read: only the bar's annotation and the printed field width; the tick span, which is what precision depends on, is measured. The crop each was transcribed from is written to docs/figures/evidence/sem_databar/ so it can be checked
method.tick_rule: a column bright over at least 80% of rows 2-90 of the databar; the outermost two such runs in the right three quarters of the strip

frames.why: saved already cropped to the field of view; the file holds no databar and nothing can be recovered from it
